name: steward-merge-duplicates

records.title: Release must publish PyPI and npm together
records.description: Matters when preparing a meta release.
records.body: The Rust release must publish meerkat-meta to PyPI and @rkat/meta-sdk to npm at the same version, in the same pass.

records.title: PyPI and npm versions ship in lockstep
records.body: Never ship the Python package without the npm package: both SDKs are released at the identical version whenever the Rust crate releases.

records.title: Operator prefers terse status updates
records.body: Keep status updates to one or two lines.

ops.title: SDK releases ship PyPI and npm in lockstep
ops.description: Matters whenever a meta release or version bump is prepared.
ops.body: A meta Rust release must publish meerkat-meta to PyPI and @rkat/meta-sdk to npm at the same version in the same pass — never one without the other.
ops.rationale: semantic duplicates merged; lineage on both sources

notes: Dedup is judgment, not hashing (§8.5): the two lockstep gotchas must merge into one record whose derived_from lists both sources (the transitive ceiling needs the merge edge), with both originals tombstoned in the same batch. The unrelated preference survives.
